name: Raindrops
source:
"Raindrops. That is where it all began... That is where our story began."

This is just a short visual novel about how someone's life changed forever, upon meeting a certain girl. Tristan (the main character) retells his tale of ten years ago: of how he got to meet the girl that changed his view of the world, his way of living, until of how they parted... You will be the one to determine how to story will end--- whether they would get to meet again, or not would be by the choice/s you make...

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/raindrops.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
“雨滴。一切都是从那里开始的…我们的故事，也是从那里开始的。”

这是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述了一个人在遇见某位女孩后，人生从此改变的故事。主人公特里斯坦回忆起十年前的经历：他如何认识了那个改变自己世界观与生活方式的女孩，以及他们后来如何分别…故事如何结束，将由你决定——他们能否再次相遇，取决于你作出的选择…

（摘自[url=http://renai.us/game/raindrops.shtml]Ren’Ai档案库[/url]）
